name: savanna-bridgeplayer
description: Savanna BridgePlayer — an embeddable accessibility plugin for existing learning websites.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run build && pnpm --filter @savanna/demo run build
scripts.dev: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run build && pnpm --filter @savanna/demo run dev
scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy
scripts.api:openapi: cd apps/api && uv run python -m scripts.export_openapi ../../packages/contracts/openapi.json
